statement.text:
(a) Are there any null-homologous Floer minimal knots with irreducible com-
plements other than the Borromean knots $B_{g}, g \geq 0$, in any 3-manifolds?
It is reasonable to make the following more concrete conjectures.
(b) Conjecture (Ni): If $b_{1}(Y) < 2$, then the only null-homologous Floer mini-
mal knot in $Y$ is the unknot.
(c) Conjecture (Ni): If the Thurston norm of $Y$ is not identically zero, then $Y$
does not contain any null-homologous Floer minimal knot with irreducible
complement.
(d) Conjecture (Hedden, Rasmussen): The only Floer minimal knots in lens
spaces are simple knots.
